name: 11369 · East Elmhurst, NY
findings: ZIP 11369 (East Elmhurst) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11369 (East Elmhurst) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
76% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11369 (East Elmhurst) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 94% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
